title.line1: MOTOR OWN DAMAGE (KASKO)/COMPULSORY MOTOR THIRD PARTY LIABILITY INSURANCE
title.line2: PRIVACY NOTICE ON THE PROTECTION OF PERSONAL DATA

aksigorta.intro: This Privacy Notice has been prepared by Aksigorta Anonim Şirketi (the “Company” and/or “Aksigorta”), in its capacity as Data Controller under Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data (the “Law”), in order to inform you within the framework of Article 10 of the Law and the Communiqué on the Procedures and Principles to be Followed in Fulfilling the Obligation to Inform, as part of fulfilling our legal obligations arising from the relevant legislation. In this context, this Privacy Notice sets out in detail the identity of the data controller and of its representative, if any, the purposes for which personal data will be processed, to whom and for what purpose personal data may be transferred, the method and legal basis of collecting personal data, and information regarding the other rights of the data subject listed in Article 11 of the Law.

section1.heading: 1. Methods of Collection and Personal Data Processed
section1.p1: Your personal data processed within the scope of Motor Own Damage/Compulsory Motor Third Party Liability insurance may be collected verbally, in writing or electronically through various means, primarily the Aksigorta website. In this context, your personal data may be collected by our Company through insurance companies, agencies, brokers, online applications, application forms, arbitration processes, the call centre, tools such as e-mail/help screens, and where necessary the relevant automotive companies, third parties such as companies from which services/products are procured, as well as public institutions and organisations authorised primarily under Insurance Law No. 5684 and the relevant legislation, and databases permitted by legislation.
section1.p2: The personal data processed within the scope of Motor Own Damage/Compulsory Motor Third Party Liability insurance is presented for your attention in the table below:

identity.label: Identity Information:
identity.value: Name and surname, Turkish ID number/foreign ID number, nationality, date of birth, gender, driving licence details, father's name, mother's name, age.

contact.label: Contact Information:
contact.value: Telephone number, fax, mobile telephone, e-mail, NVI address.

professional.label: Professional Experience Information:
professional.value: Occupation, occupation code, expertise information, education registration type.

legal.label: Legal Transaction Information:
legal.value: Information contained in correspondence with judicial authorities, information contained in case files.

customer.label: Customer Transaction Information:
customer.value: Policy number, endorsement number, policy start date, policy end date, risk address, insured party details, name of the agency from which service was received, call centre records, request details.

financial.label: Financial Information:
financial.value: Credit/bank card information, account holder, account details, IBAN number.

security.label: Transaction Security:
security.value: Customer information required for access to electronic insurance channels, IP addresses, passwords and credentials.

marketing.label: Marketing Information:
marketing.value: Cookie records, information derived through data enrichment activities, and information and assessments obtained as a result of surveys, campaigns and direct marketing activities.

sensitive.label: Special Categories of Personal Data:
sensitive.value: Health data within the scope of claims and of insurance issued for vehicles for persons with disabilities.

other.label: Other Information:
other.value: Visual and audio recordings together with vehicle information, licence plate information, necessary information relating to the vehicle,

section2.heading: 2. Purpose of Processing and Legal Basis
section2.itemA: Your personal data consisting of identity, contact, professional experience, customer transaction, financial information and other data is processed for the purposes of providing policy quotations and renewal offers, issuing policies, calculating and reporting policy premiums, querying the insured party's policy information through Aksigorta systems, carrying out payment and accounting processes, performing the obligations under the insurance contract, carrying out premium collection and refund processes, carrying out indemnity processes, and carrying out claims processes together with total loss and salvage transactions, on the basis of Article 5/2 (c) of the Law, provided that it is directly related to the establishment and performance of the insurance contract and that the processing of the personal data of the parties to the contract is necessary;
section2.itemB: Your personal data consisting of identity, contact, professional experience, customer transaction, legal transaction, financial information, transaction security and other information is processed for the purposes of carrying out identity verification processes, fulfilling the obligations arising from legislation, providing information to authorised persons, institutions and organisations, following up legal affairs, carrying out storage and archiving activities, carrying out information and transaction security processes, carrying out communication activities, evaluating and responding to recourse claims submitted by insurance companies and third parties, and carrying out risk management processes, on the basis of Article 5/2 (ç) of the Law, where processing is mandatory in order for the data controller to fulfil its legal obligation;
section2.itemC: Your personal data consisting of identity, contact, professional experience, customer transaction, legal transaction, financial information, transaction security and other information is processed for the purposes of carrying out processes relating to recourse claims against insurance companies and third parties, carrying out recourse processes submitted by insurance companies and third parties, carrying out premium collection and refund processes, carrying out indemnity processes, carrying out provision processes with health institutions and other organisations, carrying out call centre processes, providing policy quotations and renewal offers, issuing policies, calculating and reporting policy premiums, performing the obligations under the insurance contract, carrying out identity verification processes, fulfilling the obligations arising from legislation, providing information to authorised persons, institutions and organisations, following up legal affairs, carrying out storage and archiving activities, and carrying out insurance reinsurance and coinsurance processes, on the basis of Article 5/2 (e) of the Law, where processing is mandatory for the establishment, exercise or protection of a right;
section2.itemD: Your personal data consisting of identity, contact, customer transaction, legal transaction and transaction security is processed for the purposes of carrying out customer satisfaction processes, carrying out risk management processes, carrying out audit processes, carrying out reconciliation processes with supplier companies, carrying out insurance reinsurance and coinsurance processes, and carrying out communication activities, on the basis of Article 5/2 (f) of the Law, where processing is mandatory for the legitimate interests of the data controller, provided that it does not harm the fundamental rights and freedoms of the data subject;
section2.itemE: Your personal data consisting of identity, contact, customer transaction, transaction security and marketing information is processed for the purposes of carrying out marketing, advertising and campaign processes and of obtaining commercial electronic message permissions in accordance with the obligations arising from Law No. 6563 on the Regulation of Electronic Commerce and the secondary legislation deriving its legal basis therefrom (the “Electronic Commerce Legislation”), on the basis of explicit consent pursuant to Article 5/1 of the Law;
section2.itemF: Your special categories of personal data is processed for the purposes of providing policy quotations and renewal offers, issuing policies, calculating and reporting policy premiums, performing the obligations under the insurance contract, carrying out identity verification processes, fulfilling the obligations arising from legislation, providing information to authorised persons, institutions and organisations, and carrying out storage and archiving activities, on the basis of Article 6/3 (b) of the Law where expressly provided for by law and Article 6/3 (d) where mandatory for the establishment, exercise or protection of a right; and/or for the purposes of carrying out processes relating to recourse claims against insurance companies and third parties, carrying out recourse processes submitted by insurance companies and third parties, carrying out premium collection and refund processes, carrying out indemnity processes, carrying out claims processes together with total loss and salvage transactions, and carrying out legal processes, on the basis of Article 6/3 (d) of the Law where mandatory for the establishment, exercise or protection of a right.

section3.heading: 3. Transfer of Personal Data
section3.p1: With regard to the transfer of personal data, Aksigorta acts in accordance with Articles 8 and 9 of the Law and with the decisions and relevant regulations issued by the Personal Data Protection Board. In this context, our Company transfers personal data by taking the necessary security measures and limited to the purposes set out in this Privacy Notice.
section3.p2: In order to provide the services within our field of activity and to carry out quality control of the services provided, personal data may be transferred to third parties within the framework of a contractual relationship. In this context, your personal data may be shared with: business partners we cooperate with domestically, including companies providing software support services, lawyers and consultants whose services we benefit from, and business partners with whom we cooperate and/or from whom we receive services; third parties qualifying as service providers and/or intermediary service providers; authorised agencies/brokers, reinsurers, loss adjusters, assistance companies, provision service organisations, the relevant car services, salvage companies, other insurance companies, health institutions, the Insurance Information and Monitoring Centre, MASAK, the Undersecretariat of Treasury General Directorate of Insurance and the relevant official authorities within the framework of the Insurance Law and other legislative provisions, supervisory and regulatory public institutions and organisations, and contracted banks; and, only where you have given explicit consent, for the purposes of ensuring service integrity and communicating suitable opportunities and campaigns to you, and upon your request so that you may benefit from other insurance products, with Medisa Sigorta A.Ş. and Agesa Hayat ve Emeklilik A.Ş. (hereinafter Aksigorta together with Medisa Sigorta A.Ş. and Agesa Hayat ve Emeklilik A.Ş. shall be referred to as the “Insurance Group”); and, in accordance with legislation, with the cloud service provider established abroad with which we cooperate for the purpose of carrying out storage and archiving activities, and where necessary with reinsurers for the purpose of providing services.

section4.heading: 4. Rights of the Data Subject
section4.p1: By applying to our Company as the Data Controller, you have the right to: learn whether your personal data is being processed; request information if it has been processed; learn the purpose of the processing of your personal data and whether it is used in accordance with its purpose; learn whether it is transferred domestically or abroad; request its correction if it has been processed incompletely or incorrectly; request compensation for your loss if you suffer damage due to the unlawful processing of your personal data; and request the deletion or destruction of your personal data.
section4.p2: In order to exercise the rights specified in the Law, you may submit to our Company the application form available on our website, clearly stating which rights you wish to exercise, together with documents establishing your identity and in accordance with the information and procedure set out in the form. Written applications containing the above requests received from the data subject will be answered by our Company within 30 (thirty) days. If you are acting on behalf of another person in the matter you request, you must be specifically authorised in this regard and your authority must be documented, the application must contain identity and address information, and documents verifying your identity must be attached to the application.
